p: St James Street is one of Burnley's main shopping streets, so this Admiral is right where the footfall is, a short wander from the bus station and the Charter Walk centre.

It's an adults-only venue, so leave the young ones elsewhere. If you're visiting the town properly, there's more to Burnley than people expect. The Weavers' Triangle along the Leeds and Liverpool Canal is a great slice of mill-town history, Towneley Hall and its huge park sit on the edge of town, and on match days Turf Moor turns the whole place claret and blue. Worth bearing in mind that the centre gets busy when the Clarets are at home, so allow extra time for parking.
